"''Which one? Eufornis Major, or Eufornis Minor?|[[Nazhros Oleg]] and [[Zare Leonis]]|}} '''Eufornis Major''', sometimes referred to as simply '''Eufornis''', was a prestigious [[ecumenopolis]] [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Core Worlds]]. Due to their similar names, Eufornis Major was occasionally confused with [[Eufornis Minor]], a remote [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] colony world. In [[5 BBY]],{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} [[Telgordo Travel]] operated a transport service from [[Coruscant]] that stopped at Eufornis Major, as well as [[Plexis]] and [[Hosnian Prime]].{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} ==Behind the scenes== Eufornis Major was first mentioned in [[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks|''Rebel in the Ranks'']], the [[2015]] second installment in the [[Star Wars Rebels: Servants of the Empire|''Servants of the Empire'']] series of junior novels written by [[Jason Fry]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{Mo}} *''[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-episode-4-aldhani|text="Aldhani" Episode Guide | Andor}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Eufornis Major |ka=დიდი ეუფორნისი |tr=Eufornis Major }} [[Category:Ecumenopolises]] [[Category:New Republic planets]] [[Category:Planets in the Core Worlds]]
